answer_1.quote: We research focuses on ensuring the multimodal safety of MLLMs by addressing visual safety information leakage and establishing a reliable multimodal safety evaluation for MLLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include model responses to image-text queries, which are evaluated for safety (e.g., refusal, warning, or unsafe responses) in multimodal dialogue settings.

answer_2.quote: For safety tasks, we leverage the most widely used multimodal safety benchmark as our evaluation dataset... We employ LlamaGuard3-8B as the safety judge in our experiment.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as the judge model and design a classification prompt for this task shown in Figure . GPT-4o is more effective in evaluating multimodal safety data samples without VSIL.

answer_4.quote: After a final manual review by the authors, we complete our VLSBench, addressing the VSIL problem.
answer_4.guideline: The authors and three more data labelers are invited to cooperate on this verification process. (a) the textual query must be harmless without the safety-related information from the image modality; (b) the textual query must neither contradict nor be irrelevant to the image.
